label: Good
means: In its pocket, face up, the right way round: the pocket check passed it, or a person looked and vouched for it.

label: Placed, unverified
means: In tape, but the automatic pocket check did not pass it (or did not run) and nobody has looked since.

label: Placed, suspect
means: In tape, but a person reviewing its photo said it was not seated, the pocket looked empty, or it was unclear.

label: Flipped
means: In tape the wrong way round - turned 180 degrees (or 90) from the reel's orientation.

label: Lost
means: Not in tape: missed or dropped on the way, taken back out, or gone from the wafer before it could be picked.
